AmiPefService.description: The AmiPefService schema describes the Pef Alert and Alert Mail service.
AmiPefService.longDescription: The AmiPefService schema describes the root of the Pef Service. All Pef Alert and Alert Mail propertiesshowcased with this schema.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

ChannelMappings.description: The eth interface to channel number mappings for this platform.
ChannelMappings.longDescription: This property shall contain an array of readonly mappings between each eth interface name and its corresponding platform-specific ChannelNo value.

FilterEnable.description: The array of different filters required for AmiPefService.
FilterEnable.longDescription: This property shall contain the array of bytes of different sensors filters flags.

Members.longDescription: This property shall contain an array of links to the members of this collection.

Oem.longDescription: This property shall contain the OEM extensions.  All values for properties that this object contains shall conform to the Redfish Specification-described requirements.

PEFActionGblControl.description: The Global Action Control flag of Pef Service.
PEFActionGblControl.longDescription: This property shall contain the Global Action Control flag of AmiPefService.

RetryEnable.longDescription: When this is set to true, alerts are not sent immediately. Instead, they are queued as tasks and retried according to configured limits.

RetryCountLimit.description: The number of times an alert should be retried.
RetryCountLimit.longDescription: This property shall contain the maximum number of retry attempts for failed alerts.

RetryTimeInterval.description: The delay between retries in seconds.
RetryTimeInterval.longDescription: This property shall define the time interval in seconds between retry attempts.

PendingAlertsLimit.description: The maximum number of alerts that can be queued.
PendingAlertsLimit.longDescription: This property shall contain the maximum number of alerts that can be processed as pending tasks.

ChannelMapping.description: A mapping between an eth interface name and a platform channel number.
ChannelMapping.longDescription: This type shall describe a readonly mapping between a platform-specific ChannelNo value and an eth interface name that can be used with AlertPolicyTable entries.

ChannelName.longDescription: This property shall contain the eth interface name for this channel mapping.

ChannelNo.longDescription: This property shall contain the platform-specific ChannelNo value associated with the eth interface.
